title: Human Services Code (formerly the Public Welfare Code; Act of Jun. 13, 1967, P.L. 31, No. 21), Pennsylvania
deposited: the whole Act, as served by the Pennsylvania General Assembly's unconsolidated statutes viewer (HTML rendering); Article IV, Public Assistance (ss 401-493), is the part encoded; the whole Act as served is deposited
request: HTTP GET with User-Agent legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons); the URL is the one the site's own 'View Unconsolidated Statute' page loads into its iframe
version: as served on 2026-10-24; the page carries no 'current through' date. The latest amendment notes in the text are of December 2025 (Tax Reform Code: 'Dec. 22, 2025, P.L.348, No.57'; see the Act's own amendment notes)
omitted: HTML markup, and the hidden 'Comment' divisions (display:none, internal anchors such as '19710002u302v'); every visible line of the statute, its amendment notes and compiler's notes is kept, one HTML paragraph per line, as the site breaks them
converter: one-off Python script (regex + html.unescape; table cells joined with ' | '); scripts kept outside commons
licence: no terms of use restrict reuse (palegis.us/legal is a disclaimer and a DMCA notice only); statute text is not copyrightable (Georgia v. Public.Resource.Org, 590 U.S. 255 (2020))
